items.summaryZh: 阿森纳资助了为年轻难民提供支持的巴博巴中心。
bodyZh: 阿森纳基金会资助了巴博巴中心，这是一个非住院式治疗社区，为在英国寻求避难的人权虐待年轻幸存者提供整体支持。75岁的巴博巴中心主任希拉·梅尔扎克（Sheila Melzak）本人曾是一名来自东欧的难民，她向我们讲述了他们的工作。
“我一直对那些与父母、社区和文化分离的人们的坚韧与困境很感兴趣。”
“当我完成心理学大学学位后，我在哈克尼经营了一家儿童之家多年。我接受了儿童和青少年心理治疗师的培训，并在CAMHS社区心理健康服务机构工作。我曾去一家为酷刑幸存者服务的机构工作，该机构现在被称为‘免于酷刑’（Freedom from Torture）。”
“我在那里工作了近20年，服务对象是与父母分离的年轻人，或者那些与因各种原因无法照顾他们的父母生活的年轻人。我们的一群人决定成立一个新的组织，专注于满足儿童和青少年的特殊需求，他们在经历人权虐待后来到英国寻求庇护，并且与家人分离。我们成立了这个新组织，并在2010年成为一家慈善机构。”
“流亡年轻幸存者巴博巴中心采用整体方法，拥有一个多学科团队，负责照顾在英国寻求庇护的弱势年轻人的内心情感需求和外部实际需求。一旦年轻人获得难民身份，在一个与他们长大的文化截然不同的文化中，他们在获得教育、工作、福利等方面仍然会遇到许多实际问题。”
“巴博巴中心提供个人和集体心理治疗以及各种集体活动，我们作为一个社区运作，因为我们发现许多治疗参与都来自于对社区生活的参与。例如，我们举办年度乡村静修活动，并组织许多日间活动。我们还举行一个每月的社区会议，年轻人和员工一起用餐，并讨论与在英国生活有关的问题、包括冲突在内的世界局势以及巴博巴的具体问题。”
“我们的目标是让经历过暴力、丧失以及生活中许多不愉快变化的年轻人，在我们的过渡社区中得到增强，以便他们能够在流亡社区中茁壮成长并为社区生活做出贡献。”
“员工和年轻人发现锻炼具有治疗作用，因为它可以减轻他们体内的紧张和焦虑。我们将阿森纳基金会的资金用于我们的困难救助基金，特别是通过改善他们获得体育和锻炼活动的机会来支持年轻难民和寻求庇护者的心理健康。这笔资金使年轻人能够获得健身房会员资格，并使我们能够为赤贫基金做出贡献——许多年轻人会经历赤贫时期。”
“当许多年轻人抵达英国时，他们的信誉受到质疑，包括他们的年龄。如果评估他们的人不相信他们是未成年人，他们就会被安置在内政部的住所里，给他们的生活费非常少。所有来到该中心的年轻人都有严重的心理健康问题和发育困难。”
“他们很享受锻炼，并且似乎在锻炼中蓬勃发展。他们也都喜欢看足球。过去，我们曾有一些支持者带我们的年轻人去阿森纳，他们喜欢有机会观看一场真正的足球比赛，我们期待着在这次资助下前往酋长球场参观。”
“我们希望他们的未来包括建立新生活和从创伤中恢复。我们的经验是，如果我们的年轻人能够面对生活中的困难，并庆祝他们在现在已经拥有和拥有的机会，他们将最能够应对未来生活的挑战。我们的目标是帮助年轻人应对创伤、分离和丧失的影响，并在英国建立有意义的生活。”

items.titleEn: David O'Leary
bodyEn: On playing ability alone David O’Leary would still have made this list. Chuck in the small matter of 722 appearances, a Club record, and it is easy to understand why this gentle, unassuming man is held in such high regard at Arsenal.

Of course, adoration for long-serving players is not uncommon, but the London-born defender had plenty more than just longevity in his locker. O’Leary was an imperious centre-half who, despite a slender physique, was deceptively powerful. He had pace too, the kind of speed that was rare in players with a similar six-foot frame.

The Republic of Ireland international (he qualified through parentage) originally signed apprentice forms in 1973 and in the early days of his Arsenal career — he made his debut just three months after his 17th birthday in 1975 — provided a touch of youthful exuberance in an aging, and struggling, side. Terry Mancini, a short-term acquisition from Queens Park Rangers, may have drawn most of the plaudits for plugging a leaky defence, but O’Leary’s role in steering the Gunners clear of relegation is not be underestimated.

David was a cultured and composed player, full of grace both in his use of the ball and the manner he loped across the field; he became affectionately known as ‘Spider’. O’Leary oozed calmness too; only in the most critical of situations would he opt to lump the ball forward, instead choosing to build from the back.

While his countrymen, Messrs Brady and Stapleton, sought pastures new at the start of the 1980s, O’Leary remained a stalwart in the Arsenal rearguard. He had turned from hot prospect to well-rounded centrepiece and attained the captaincy for a period of 18 months early in the new decade. But as the Club hovered in the midst of mediocrity, David needed a lift.

The arrival of George Graham in 1986 bought renewed vigour from the Gunners’ No 5 and he steadily regained his status as one of the League’s most reliable defenders. But the Littlewoods Cup triumph of 1987 proved to be the last season in which O’Leary would command a regular berth. An ankle injury sidelined him for much of the following campaign and his involvement in the title-winning surge in 1989 was sporadic. It came largely at right-back but nevertheless he completed his duties with aplomb.

It earned him further respect and three years later O’Leary was spending more time in the side than out of it. Fittingly for such a loyal servant, his swansong, in his 20th season of association with the Club, was the 1993 FA Cup Final. The Gunners defeated Sheffield Wednesday at Wembley and David, a substitute on the day, hoisted one final piece of silverware. It was a special end to a very special playing career with Arsenal.

items.titleEn: Overmars - I’m glad Wenger took gamble
items.summaryEn: ‘I’m very happy Wenger could see my potential. The year after, I had the best season of my career’
bodyEn: Marc Overmars says his first season at Arsenal was the best of his career - after Arsene Wenger took a “gamble” on him.
The Holland international joined the club in June 1997 from Ajax, not long after recovering from a serious knee injury.
as the Gunners won the Double in his first season in England, and he says it was an unforgettable time for him.
“[When I signed] people were saying, ‘No, he is not good enough, he is not at this level’,” he told Arsenal Player.
“I had a bad surgery on my knee, when you are 22 years old it is quite a tough injury - especially in those days. But for me, there was no doubt. I just needed to recover and be there again.
“I’m very happy Wenger could see past that and see my potential as a player. He saw it, and it was a strength of his to take the gamble. The year after that, I had the best year of my career.
“In that period, we were playing and feeling like we were unbeatable. It was the best period of my life as a football player.
“We had Ray Parlour, who had done extremely well. He delivered so much power and work so I could play with more risk up front because Ray was doing a lot of the defensive work.
“Same for Petit, same for Vieira - they let me play a little bit higher so that is why I could score a lot of goals.
“In my opinion, if it is an English team, it doesn’t matter if you are Arsenal or Chelsea or Manchester United, you have to get the base of English players.
“You have to get that idea, because it is good to have that feeling of support and the area and support as a fan.”

items.titleEn: When Wenger predicted Arteta's coaching future
items.summaryEn: Find out what Arsene Wenger said about Mikel Arteta when he was manager in 2015
bodyEn: Back in May 2015, Arsene Wenger said “there was never a doubt” in his mind that Mikel Arteta would become a successful coach.
The Spanish midfielder hung up his boots amid emotional scenes on the final day of the season as Arsenal beat Aston Villa 4-0 at Emirates Stadium.
Arteta is now expected to take up a coaching role and Wenger says the 34-year-old has all the attributes to succeed.
“First of all he was the captain of the team, so he has leadership qualities,” the boss told Arsenal Player. “He is a winner and he is focused every day to do well.
“He has an impact on his partners. That is a little bit difficult to explain sometimes, but I believe he is highly focused on football. He has a passion, like Spanish people do, for the game.

“When you get to 30 you start to envisage your life and your future without playing football. Slowly it matures inside you and there was never a doubt in my mind, the way I see him behave every day, that he would finish in football, and I think he will do very well.”

items.titleZh: 温格曾预测阿尔特塔的执教未来
items.summaryZh: 回顾温格在2015年对米克尔·阿尔特塔执教前景的评价。
bodyZh: 早在2015年5月，阿尔塞纳·温格就表示，他从“从未怀疑过”米克尔·阿尔特塔会成为一名成功的教练。
这位西班牙中场在赛季最后一天的酋长球场挂靴，当时阿森纳以4比0击败阿斯顿维拉，场面感人。
阿尔特塔预计将担任教练职务，温格表示这位34岁的年轻人具备成功所需的所有素质。
“首先他是球队的队长，所以他具备领导才能，”主教练对阿森纳球员频道表示。“他是一个赢家，每天都专注于做好事情。”
“他对队友有影响力。这有时有点难以解释，但我相信他对足球高度专注。他对比赛有着像西班牙人一样激情的热爱。”
“当你到了30岁时，你开始设想没有足球的生活和未来。这种想法慢慢在你的心中成熟，从我每天看到他的行为举止来看，我从未怀疑过他会在足球界走到最后，我认为他会做得非常好。”

items.titleEn: Overmars - I was so grateful for Parlour
items.summaryEn: Dutch international winger on Wenger’s gamble and the players who helped him shine during his Arsenal career
bodyEn: Marc Overmars says that he was allowed to take more risks as an Arsenal player thanks to Ray Parlour’s “power and work rate”.

The former Netherlands winger played a vital part in the Gunners' double-winning season of 1997/98, forming a devastating front line with Ian Wright, Dennis Bergkamp and Nicolas Anelka - who scored a combined 58 goals in all competitions.
However, despite the team's creativity in attack, Overmars says that he would not have been as effective without his team-mates’ hard work.
“In that period we were playing and feeling like we were unbeatable,” he told Arsenal Player. “It was the best period of my life as a footballer.

“We had Ray Parlour who did extremely well. He delivered so much power and work rate so that I could be more risky up front because Ray was doing a lot of defensive work, and that’s the same for Emmanuel Petit and Patrick Vieira.
“They let me play a bit higher up which is why I could score more goals.

"In an English team, it doesn’t matter if it’s Arsenal, Chelsea or United, you have to get a base of the English players, like Ray. That’s my opinion, because then it’s good to have that connection with your supporters and the area around you.”

items.titleZh: 奥维马斯：我非常感激雷·帕劳尔
items.summaryZh: 荷兰边锋回顾阿森纳生涯，坦言队友的付出让自己受益匪浅。
bodyZh: 马克·奥维马斯表示，多亏了雷·帕劳尔的“力量和工作效率”，他在作为阿森纳球员时才得以承担更多风险。
这位前荷兰边锋在阿森纳1997/98赛季的双冠王征程中发挥了至关重要的作用，他与伊恩·赖特、丹尼斯·博格坎普和尼古拉·阿内尔卡组成了一条极具杀伤力的锋线，他们在各项赛事中一共攻入58球。
然而，尽管球队在进攻端极具创造力，奥维马斯表示，如果没有队友们的努力，他不可能发挥出如此高的效率。
他告诉阿森纳球员频道：“在那段时间里，我们的踢球方式和感觉就像是不可战胜的。这是我足球生涯中最美好的时期。”
“我们有雷·帕劳尔，他表现得极其出色。他提供了巨大的力量和工作效率，所以我可以在前场承担更多风险，因为雷做了大量的防守工作，伊曼纽尔·佩蒂特和帕特里克·维埃拉也是如此。”
“他们让我能够踢得更靠前，这也是我能进更多球的原因。”
“在一支英格兰球队里，无论是阿森纳、切尔西还是曼联，你都必须拥有以雷这样的英格兰球员为基础的班底。这是我的看法，因为这样才能与球迷以及你周围的社区建立良好的联系。”
